commentary.text: 90+4' That's it for today, Samuel Barrott has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' Kevin Schade (Brentford) outjumps his marker and heads the resulting corner high over the bar.
90+2' Dango Ouattara (Brentford) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The corner is swung in but Brentford can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
87' Here comes a substitution. Morato (Nottingham) is brought on as a substitute for Callum Hudson-Odoi.
85' Mathias Jensen finds the head of Dango Ouattara (Brentford) with a clever free kick, and he crashes in a powerful close-range header at goal that just flies over the bar. Unlucky!
85' Neco Williams (Nottingham) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Brentford.
81' Keith Andrews has decided to make a change. Jordan Henderson (Brentford) replaces Yegor Yarmolyuk.
81' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Michael Kayode walks off the pitch to be replaced by Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford).

79' 0 - 2 Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Caoimhin Kelleher is just a bystander as the ball flies into the bottom left corner. The score is 0:2.

76' Igor Thiago (Brentford) is furious with himself as he misses a golden opportunity from inside the six-yard box. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
74' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
70' The game is interrupted as Igor Thiago (Brentford) is flagged offside.
68' Substitution. Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) on for Igor Jesus.
67' Keith Andrews has decided to substitute Rico Henry and he is replaced by Aaron Hickey (Brentford).
66' Yellow card. Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
61' Here's the change. Nicolas Dominguez leaves the pitch and Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) comes on as a substitute.
55' The current number of corner kicks is 4:5.
50' Dango Ouattara (Brentford) jumps highest to win the header from the corner, but his close-range attempt is well blocked by a defender.
50' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) takes the corner.
49' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Brentford.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+8' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+7' Sepp van den Berg (Brentford) latches onto a lofted pass from Michael Kayode on the edge of the six-yard box, but misdirects his header and sends it just wide of the left post.
45+3' Brentford failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
45+2' The ball goes out of play and it will be a corner kick.
45' 7 additional min. will be played.
43' The game is interrupted now, Murillo (Nottingham) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

40' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Dango Ouattara (Brentford) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Matz Sels pulls off a brilliant save.
37' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Mikkel Damsgaard leaves the pitch to be replaced by Dango Ouattara (Brentford).
37' Problems for Keith Andrews as Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Sepp van den Berg replaces him.
36' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
34' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
33' The free kick is delivered by Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
30' The resulting corner from Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) comes to nothing.
28' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play.
26' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Nottingham comes to nothing.
25' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt.
21' Nottingham take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

19' Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) is untouchable as he tricks his way into the box. His shot, though, lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies a whisker wide of the right post. That would have been a great goal! The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
19' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) collects an inch-perfect pass and strikes the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked.
12' 0 - 1 Igor Jesus (Nottingham) gets on the end of a long pass that is slotted through the defence and easily sends the ball into the bottom left corner!
9' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) misses with a poor header from a rebound on the edge of the penalty area, directing his effort high over the crossbar!
8' Nottingham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

7' What a great touch by Igor Jesus (Nottingham) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the right side of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. The ball goes out of play. Nottingham are awarded a corner kick.
7' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
6' Ola Aina (Nottingham) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The linesman makes the right call and Nottingham will have a corner.
3' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
2' Igor Thiago (Brentford) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot a whisker past the right post.
1' The first half has just begun.
Brentford will kick-off.
Samuel Barrott got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
